name: ADVANCED EXPERTISE TECHNOLOGY PVT. LTD.
india_angle: The company is based in India and provides solutions for various industries, including chemicals and pharmaceuticals.
summary: Advanced Expertise Technology Pvt. Ltd. specializes in providing fluoropolymer coating and lining solutions, primarily for industries dealing with corrosive and abrasive products. Their expertise in coatings is applicable to equipment used in chemical processing, which may have indirect relevance to semiconductor manufacturing environments.
